chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who doubts in the Fajr prayer. He said: He repeats it. I said: The Maghrib? He said: Yes, and the Witr and the Jumuʿah, without my asking him.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةُ: the Jumuʿah prayer, the Friday congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn obligatory salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبُ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat (prayer)
key_terms.شَكَّ: doubted; experienced uncertainty in the prayer
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he repeats; he must perform the prayer again

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on doubting during Fajr, Maghrib, Witr, and Jumuʿah prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in certain prayers. It states that if one doubts in the Fajr prayer, he must repeat it, and the same ruling applies to Maghrib, Witr, and Jumuʿah.
